text_block_list.text:
It's time for the spring Tenno Sho, one of
Gold
Ship's big landmark races for the
year, and she is
acting as strange as
ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh-hohoho! Refined laughter echoes
throughout
the paddock. By learning the
ways of etiquette,
Голд Шип has
transformed into the noblest of

Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Эйсин Флэш blocks her path.
For the
sake of victory and a clue, Gold
Ship must
elegantly dance―nay, race
her way to the goal!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
